notes.title: A new chapter and a new boss! Will you be able to defeat him?
Added difficulty modifiers, new cards, and passives!
notes.content:
Greetings! 

Deck of Souls has a brand-new bumper update! We combined the second and fourth stages of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2088770/view/4209257868264101772]roadmap[/url] into one release.

We've listened to players and have implemented the option to change the card placed under an enemy. Now, the card will return to your hand and the spent stamina used to play it will be returned accordingly. However, you can only do this three times per battle, so choose wisely.

Here's what else is new in the latest update: 
[list]
[*] Added difficulty modifiers, which players will unlock by completing the third act.
[*] Added the ability to permanently improve the hero's stats between runs. This option will become available at level 5. If you have already reached this level, you will need to replay it to unlock the new feature. 
[*] Added 3 new cards. 
[*] Added 3 new passives. 
[/list]
Play Deck of Souls and let us know what you think. 

Thanks to everyone who supports Deck of Souls! It keeps us motivated to keep working on the game! 

Regards,
Deck of Souls Team

notes.title: Deck of Souls is out Early Access! See the roadmap!
notes.content:
Greetings! 

We're excited to announce that Deck of Souls is finally available in Early Access. Thank you to everyone who added the game to the Wishlist and supported us during the development. We hope you enjoy the game and have a lot of fun fighting the forces of Heaven and Hell. Your feedback and comments are very welcome – they will help us to continue making Deck of Souls better and more interesting. 

[previewyoutube=0-0eWh-Ov18;full][/previewyoutube]

Want to know what we'll add to the game before the full release? Check out our plans for the game's development time in Early Access. 

[h2][b]Early Access [/b][/h2]
Deck of Souls' Early Access will contain: 
[list]
[*] 3 hero classes: Holy Lich, Divine Knight, and Saint Talon – including numerous cards for each. There will be 77 cards for Holy Lich, 61 cards for Warrior, 64 cards for Saint Talon, and 32 neutral cards; 
[*] 3 incredible story chapters to replay over and over again;
[*] 3 deadly bosses, each with the challenging two-stage battles; 
[*] 3 different merchants;
[*] Unique items for each class, consisting of 28 items for the Holy Lich, 19 for the Saint Talon, 28 for the Warrior, 9 neutral items, and 7 relics; 
[*] 55 unique combat encounters, including bosses and random events; 
[*] 83 different nodes that treasure-filled glory or deadly combat encounters; 
[*] Over 140 different passives, but you'll have to play the game to uncover all of them!
[/list]
[h2][b]Update 1[/b][/h2]
We plan to add new hero equipment and enemies. We will also implement a number of QoL improvements based on feedback from players. 

[h2][b]Update 2[/b][/h2]
The most important changes in this update: 
[list]
[*] In-between-run upgrades: permanently improving hero stats, gaining new skills, and more.
[*] Run difficulty modifiers.
[*] New cards.
[*] New passives.
[/list]
[h2][b]Update 3[/b][/h2]
The following additions will become available:
[list]
[*] The fourth chapter of the story.
[*] New biome: the Castle. 
[*] A new boss.
[*] New random events.
[*] More enemies. 
[*] As well as two new sub-bosses.
[/list]
[h2][b]Update 4[/b][/h2]
While Deck of Souls is in Early Access, we'll read and consider all of the comments, reviews, and feedback from players. Feel free to share your ideas for the game with us, and we'll add the most relevant ones during this update.

In addition, we will add: 
[list]
[*] New events.
[*] New items.
[*] More QoL improvements.
[/list]
[h2][b]Update 5[/b][/h2]
In the final update, we'll release:
[list]
[*] Final chapter and end of story.
[*] Final boss.
[*] New biome: Hell.
[*] New enemies.   
[*] 4 new sub-bosses.
[/list]

Of course, at all stages, we will accept your bug reports and suggestions for improving the game. Share your thoughts and ideas with us in [url=https://discord.gg/dc75FEbaRM]Discord[/url] or Discussions on Steam.  

And now, choose a hero and go on a dangerous journey to meet angels, demons, villains, mages, and other inhabitants of the mysterious world of Deck of Souls. 

Regards,
Deck of Souls Team

notes.title: We reworked the visuals and here's a sneak peek at new backgrounds
notes.content:
Greetings!

Over the last few months, we've been hard at work making Deck of Souls the best-looking game it can be. Today, we want to talk about a few of these graphical changes.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/PrM784K/1.gif[/img]

Firstly, we were tasked with creating a dungeon, which is no simple task. It's an unusual location and requires a thick atmosphere with eye-catching features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/b4a3a493d155bc51d7e68bfa5f93e0647e2b9ce6.png[/img]

We started with a few basic shapes to define the floor and dingy walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/4e398ebb2c82c7308f2ceb3d858a76608165190e.png[/img]

After the preliminary sketches, we decided to add some variety by including a ruined wall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/426f122de407265de99bf111dc7be97e14e194fd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/38936bd7d14066cbceb5dc6bbdaed5fa7bf30e5f.png[/img]

The wall still looked a bit too clean (even with a big hole in it!). The brickwork was a bit dull, even after we added in a few more accessories, like a door, flags, torches, and grates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/33caaa60bf7a45ee3eb41f7666076167d6a63008.png[/img]

And then we thought about a cave or a grotto. After sketching out a cave rift, we decided to add a crystal mine as a background feature. It not only adds depth and atmosphere to the area but reveals a bit more lore of the game.

It's not just a mine – it's the ancient temple of the fallen angel who imbued the crystals with magic. Each crystal is a piece of the angel's soul, imbuing it with extraordinary power. Centuries later, instead of honoring the powerful being, people began to mine the crystals, and the ancient temple was rebuilt as a prison.

That's not all! In fact, more locations, the appearances of heroes and enemies, and the cards are all receiving visual updates.  Additionally, we continue to tweak the balance and add new enemies and new cards. The game will look completely different in the next demo! 

Thank you for supporting Deck of Souls. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/jejBb3JvNw]Discord[/url] to share your impressions, and chat with other players and the developer. 

Regards,
Deck of Souls Team

notes.title: Devlog #2: Book of Souls, many changes to mechanics, and new cards
notes.content:
Greetings!

The development of Deck of Souls is well underway and progressing smoothly. The Book of Souls is almost complete and will show players an overview of their card collection and overall game progress.

We have also added brand new cards, a discard pile, starter decks for the Rogue and Warrior classes, and four new starter decks for the Caster class (bringing it up to six!).

And we have started work on improving the interface. If you have already played the Deck of Souls demo, we would love to hear your thoughts and ideas about the interface – it will greatly help us. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/edde8d0b8bfe78443b8ec097e1768ca698e33e26.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/f0ef4702f51eb4ec403a616317768f08f0993188.png[/img]

There are also several changes to card mechanics:
[list]
[*] Stealth is now lost when dealing damage;
[*] Snack Attack makes the card instant when in stealth;
[*] Rush cards are now automatically applied if they are added to the deck and if the Rush value this turn allows it.
[*] You can no longer draw the same card twice. Once the deck is completely drawn, it will recharge from the discard pile. It's possible to have an empty deck and draw no cards.
[/list]
We've made the following additional changes:
[list]
[*] Added new cards;
[*] Cards now display the class they belong to;
[*] Added mechanics that enable players to discover and search for cards in the deck;
[*] An indicator to show player damage increases;
[*] Added effects for cards.
[/list]
Thank you for supporting Deck of Souls! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/fBSFex4YvT]Discord[/url] to share your impressions and chat with other players and the developer. 

Regards,
Deck of Souls Team

notes.title: The Deck of Souls Devlog #1
notes.content:
Greetings! 

We're happy to announce that the development on Deck of Souls is in full swing. There are so many details that we want to share with you, specifically how we are improving the card system, adding more randomness to the gameplay, more merchants, and reworking the classes. Here's an overview of our progress.

[b]The Rarity of Cards[/b]
All cards will be divided into basic, rare, epic, and legendary types – their rarity will depend on combat difficulty. For example, defeating two tough foes will grant you a choice of three rare cards, while you will be granted an epic card choice for defeating mini-bosses. As for legendary cards, well, you'll have to execute a boss to receive one of those.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/958ca6cdecea6dd12b491779cd473e7db90f6d80.gif[/img]

[b]Set of Souls[/b]
Souls are a currency that can be used in different ways to enhance your deck – the game is called Deck of Souls, after all. There are three types of souls in the game: Dull, Bright, and Radiant. Dull souls can be obtained by defeating normal enemies, Brights are trophies from downing mini-bosses, and Radiant souls can only be obtained from executing bosses. Choosing to execute bosses will give you a legendary opportunity to craft exceptional cards or an amazing equipment upgrade. Card sets or enhancements can be acquired at one of the merchant's spots – the Soul Chamber or Soul Blacksmith.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/7cc3c12e79a2c26618d6846ca91cd4144c11fb9d.gif[/img]

[b]Widening of Classes[/b]
Instead of focusing on the quantity of classes, we decided to create a more in-depth class design, offering a diverse array of class types, builds, and varied playstyles. By reducing the total number of classes, focuses on several basic archetypes with huge room for improvisation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/e277d5ba9be6c385e4cf19645392e9aa6675e660.gif[/img]

[b]Growing of Lore [/b]
Along with the game's mechanics and features, we'll also be expanding the lore! Deck of Souls will be more captivating and intriguing, but we can't give you any details just yet…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/ce12dd40a02f13cea214a364b101d74b208c7b46.gif[/img]

Thanks for your huge support, it really helps us to create an amazing game!

Regards, 
The Deck of Souls Team

notes.title: Deck of Souls announcement trailer!
notes.content:
Hello friends!

Important news from our team! Firstly, the game changed its name to Deck of Souls, don't lose us. Secondly, watch our first trailer. 

Deck of Souls is a souls-like roguelite card game with RPG elements. Create your own hero, extract souls of your enemies and make cards out of them, break through tough battles, die, and go all over again...

[previewyoutube=CwPWsqLhv3c;full][/previewyoutube]

In Deck of Souls, you will:
[list]
[*] Turn your enemies' souls into your cards and mix different classes’ abilities to uncover your true power. 
[*] Choose your hero’s capabilities and appearance, pick between several distinct classes, use the RPG elements and inventory system to your advantage, and take the proper outfit. 
[*] Make choices and decide the bosses’ fate. Execute them for their sins or spare them, so that they will come to help.
[/list]
Add Deck of Souls to your Wishlist and follow to the Steam page, so you don't miss news and updates.

Regards,
Deck of Souls Team
